summary: A 30 second launch film for an AI image tool: a spoken-in-type promise, the product revealed inside a real room, one prompt typed in close-up, the system visibly working, the result multiplying into a gallery, then the tagline.
grammar: Word, then thing: every text beat is answered by a beat that shows what the words promised.
One focal element per beat, centred, with wide empty space around it.
Text is short (2 to 7 words), sentence case, and builds word by word or letter by letter; it never just appears.
A bass hit marks each arrival: it lands on the hard cut or up to 0.25 s before it, never after.
Silence is used three times, each right after a payoff, so the next beat starts from quiet.
The interface is shown twice at two scales: whole screen for context, then an extreme close-up of the one line being typed.
The wait is made visible: a short list of steps ticks in, one soft rising note per step.
One result first, held in silence, then many: the gallery arrives on a run of hits that speeds up.
Light neutral backdrop for system and result beats, saturated gradient only for the opening and the tagline.

style.type: one geometric sans, regular weight, small relative to the frame; braces { } frame the key phrase
motifs: four small black squares drifting to the corners of the phrase
false-colour (thermal) version of footage resolving into the real picture
style.camera: no camera moves on text beats; a slow push on the room; a jump from wide interface to macro on the typed line

beats.text: Imagine to have all your tool
beats.visual: soft gradient with a blurred silhouette drifting; one line of small type centred
beats.motion: type writes in left to right over 1 s while its colour sweeps from pink to white

beats.visual: pixel-edged wipe clears the gradient to flat neutral; phrase inside braces
beats.motion: words arrive one at a time (in, one, place) about 0.35 s apart; four black squares drift outward

beats.visual: the word splits and three tiny thumbnails of the product's output sit in the gap
beats.motion: the gap opens, thumbnails swap twice, then everything fades out over the last 0.4 s

beats.role: product reveal in a real place
beats.visual: a room with a desk and one monitor, first in false colour, resolving into the real picture; the product is on the monitor
beats.motion: false colour dissolves to real over 1.4 s with a slow push in

beats.visual: closer shot of the same desk, monitor centred, wordmark readable on screen
the product's start screen full frame: wordmark behind one prompt bar

beats.text: a neo goth model for a clo|
beats.visual: extreme close-up of the prompt line, type as tall as a third of the frame
beats.motion: letters appear at typing speed while the line scrolls left to keep the caret in view

beats.text: Create a neo goth model for a clothing brand.
beats.visual: back to the whole interface with the finished prompt; the cursor presses send
beats.motion: snap back to wide in 0.25 s, click at 13.0, bar empties, then a held second

beats.visual: a title, then four steps listed under it (Processing, Generating, Image, Assemble), then a grid of coloured dots
beats.motion: title slides to the top-left; one step ticks in about every 0.3 s; the dots gather where the result will be

beats.visual: one portrait card centred on the neutral backdrop; it flips to show alternative takes
beats.motion: dots resolve into the card in 0.4 s; the card flips about once a second; held in silence at the end

beats.visual: the card multiplies into a row of cards that grows from the centre; single words appear beside it
beats.motion: a new card on every hit; the hits come faster in the middle (0.24 s, then 0.13 s, then 0.21 s apart)

beats.text: The AI powered platform for modern creatives
beats.visual: warm gradient returns; small centred line; in the last 1.5 s a product screenshot card flies in
beats.motion: line builds word by word over 1.5 s, holds 2 s in silence, then the card arrives
